model_annotations.Bulgarian: Figure 5 presents four line graphs illustrating the Train/Response Length, Train/Self-reflection and Train/Ratio Upper/Lower of ground truth and SRPO (Self-reflection and correction) for RL training curves. The horizontal axis, shared across all four graphs, represents Train/Response Length and is labeled as "Length," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, marked with intervals of 100. The vertical axes are labeled "Reward" (for the first and second graphs), "Ratio" (for the third graph) and "Offset" (for the fourth graph).  The first graph, representing Train/Reward, has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, marked with intervals of 100. The second graph, Train/Self-reflection, has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, marked with intervals of 0.2. The third graph, Train/Ratio Upper/Lower, has a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.110, marked with intervals of 0.020. The fourth graph, Train/Ratio Clipping Upper/Lower, has a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.10, marked with intervals of 0.02. Each graph displays two lines: one representing ground truth data in blue and another representing SRPO data in orange.  In the first graph (Train/Reward), the ground truth line starts at 0 and gradually increases to approximately 450 by a length of 1000, while the SRPO line begins around 70 and increases to about 480. In the second graph (Train/Self-reflection), both lines start around 0.1, reaching approximately 0.85 at a length of 1000. The third graph (Train/Ratio Upper/Lower) shows both lines starting around 0.01, and increasing to approximately 0.09. The fourth graph (Train/Ratio Clipping Upper/Lower) indicates both lines starting around 0.01 and increasing to approximately 0.08. The lines are continuous throughout the visible length of the graphs, exhibiting steadily increasing trends.
model_annotations.Chinese: Figure 5 presents three line graphs titled "Training curves for SRPQ and QLian: (a) sample length, (b) response length, and (c) upper bound." The x-axis, horizontally, represents "Train/Response Length" spanning from 0 to 1000, marked in increments of 100. The y-axis, vertically, displays values ranging from 0 to 500 in graph (a), 0 to 1000 in graph (b), and 0 to 0.114 in graph (c), with uniform numerical increments of 50 on the y-axis for graphs (a) and (b) and 0.022 for graph (c). Each graph displays three colored lines representing different training stages: "Train," "Self-reflection," and "Train/Self-reflection." In graph (a), the "Train" line (light blue) starts at 0.01 and rises, the "Self-reflection" line (orange) begins at 0.02 and rises, while the "Train/Self-reflection" line (dark blue) also starts at 0.01 and is nearly identical to the "Train" line. Graph (b) mirrors this pattern but with the lines extending to higher values; the "Train" line (light blue) rises to approximately 300, the "Self-reflection" line (orange) reaches about 500, and the "Train/Self-reflection" line (dark blue) follows the "Train" line closely. Graph (c) is different; the “Train” line (light blue) stays around 0.003, the "Self-reflection" line (orange) also stays around 0.003 and the “Train/Self-reflection” line (dark blue) shows a similar behavior. There is no apparent sorting or visual highlighting of any particular data points or lines within the graphs.
model_annotations.English: Figure 5 illustrates generated samples during RL training, separated into "train" and "realtest" categories, and further categorized by "SRPQ" and "baseline." The horizontal axis displays "Train/Response Length," scaled linearly from 0 to 500 and labeled in increments of 100. The vertical axis represents "Sample Length in tokens," with values ranging from 0 to 1000, labeled in increments of 100. Four bar charts are presented, each depicting the distribution of sample lengths for a specific condition. The "train SRPQ" chart, colored in orange, shows bars ranging in length from approximately 50 to 620 tokens. The "train baseline" chart, colored in purple, reveals bar lengths ranging from approximately 20 to 680 tokens. The "realtest SRPQ" chart, colored in green, displays bar lengths extending from nearly 0 to 480 tokens. The "realtest baseline" chart, colored in blue, shows bar lengths ranging from approximately 30 to 600 tokens. All four charts display a general trend of increasing frequency towards shorter lengths and decreasing frequency towards longer lengths. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard color and width. The bars in each chart are not explicitly sorted.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Trainingskurven für SRPO- und Baseline-Ansätze für die Aufgaben der Inferenz von Gründen in Testfällen. Die horizontale Achse stellt die Trainings-/Antwortlänge dar, die von 0 bis 100 reicht und in 10er-Schritten unterteilt ist. Die vertikale Achse zeigt den SRPO-Verhältnis-Wert, der von 0 bis 1 reicht und in 0,1er-Schritten unterteilt ist. Es werden drei Linien dargestellt: eine grüne Linie, die den SRPO-Trainingsverlauf darstellt, eine blaue Linie, die den SRPO-Self-Reflection-Verlauf darstellt, und eine orange Linie, die den Baseline-Trainingsverlauf darstellt. Der SRPO-Trainingsverlauf beginnt bei 0 auf 100 Trainings-/Antwortlänge und steigt allmählich bis zu etwa 0,8 auf 100 Trainings-/Antwortlänge an. Der SRPO-Self-Reflection-Verlauf beginnt bei einem Wert von 0,1 auf 100 Trainings-/Antwortlänge und steigt bis zu etwa 0,9 auf 100 Trainings-/Antwortlänge an. Der Baseline-Trainingsverlauf beginnt bei einem Wert von 0,1 auf 100 Trainings-/Antwortlänge und steigt bis zu etwa 0,6 auf 100 Trainings-/Antwortlänge an. Die grüne und blaue Linie überlappen sich bis etwa 50 Trainings-/Antwortlänge. Die grüne Linie ist durch eine dickere Linie dargestellt als die blaue Linie.
